author: Codex independent source auditor
scope: All 76 Author 2 ledger source/excerpt entries; Column N attribution, fidelity, pinpoint, historical scope. No ratings or underlying-answer adjudication.
limitations: Preserved text with surrounding headings/context is the principal evidence; this is not exhaustive visual PDF inspection.
Extra listed cases inspected at identity/opening-context level; one quoted passage does not validate all listed cases.
Original queries and rating rationales were not independently audited.
Online judicial-text reproductions are distinguished from authenticated primary page scans.
No legal correctness or full validation certification; no edits to XLSX/manuscript/data.

status_definitions.available_source_exact_scenario_unresolv: Preserved relevant source exists; exact-query applicability unresolved.
status_definitions.limited_primary_web_support_version_unre: Official indexed heading support only; full dated/current code unavailable.
